updates.note: Management stated working capital cycle is expected to revert to steady-state range of 45 to 50 days.
updates.quote: On a normalized basis, we expect the working capital cycle to revert to our steady-state range of 45 to 50 days.

updates.note: Reiterated target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by FY2030.
updates.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.

updates.note: Reiterated EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030 for FMEG.
updates.quote: progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.

updates.note: Reiterated EHV capacity expected to come on stream by end of this calendar year.
updates.quote: Capacity is expected to come on stream by end of this calendar year.

updates.note: Reiterated annual capex guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum, reporting INR 14.8 billion incurred in FY26.
updates.quote: During FY26, we incurred capex of INR 14.8 billion, in line with our annual guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum.

new_promises.statement: Achieve a 30% dividend payout ratio by financial year 2030.
new_promises.quote: move steadily towards our stated objective of exceeding 30% by FY 2030.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: Execute a planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years.
new_promises.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
